name: MEDS 5335
title: Advanced Molecular and Cellular Immunology I
description: Major areas covered include: (1) Development of the immune system with respect to lymphoid organs and lymphocyte subsets; (2) Mechanisms of antigen processing and presentation; (3) Lymphocyte activation including the role of costimulatory molecules and (4) Regulation of the immune response including tolerance induction, cytokine interactions and signal transduction.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
